content.text: The bug was in my Python test helper (8-byte varints), not the implementation. Let me fix the tests:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/devtests && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='qlib.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("    return b'\\xc0' + v.to_bytes(8,'big')","    return b'\\xc0' + (v & ((1<<56)-1)).to_bytes(7,'big')")
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='test_audit.py'
s=open(p).read()
# fix stream final test payloads
s=s.replace("""           dg(short_header(b'\\xaa', 0, b'\\x0b\\x00\\x01a'), [0]),
           dg(short_header(b'\\xaa', 1, b'\\x0f\\x00\\x01\\x00b'), [0])])""",
"""           dg(short_header(b'\\xaa', 0, b'\\x0b\\x00\\x01a'), [0]),
           dg(short_header(b'\\xaa', 1, b'\\x0f\\x00\\x00\\x01b'), [0])])""")
s=s.replace("""           dg(short_header(b'\\xaa', 0, b'\\x09\\x00\\x01a'), [0]),
           dg(short_header(b'\\xaa', 1, b'\\x0d\\x00\\x00\\x01a'), [0])])""",
"""           dg(short_header(b'\\xaa', 0, b'\\x09\\x00a'), [0]),
           dg(short_header(b'\\xaa', 1, b'\\x0d\\x00\\x00a'), [0])])""")
s=s.replace("check('max.data', r['send_max_data']==0x2020, r['send_max_data'])","check('max.data', r['send_max_data']==0x2020, r['send_max_data'])")
s=s.replace("r = runA([(b'\\x10\\x40\\x20' + b'\\x11\\x00\\x40\\x10' + b'\\x12\\x02' + b'\\x13\\x03', 0)])",
            "r = runA([(b'\\x10\\x60\\x20' + b'\\x11\\x00\\x50\\x10' + b'\\x12\\x02' + b'\\x13\\x03', 0)])")
# ncid limit: the second new connection id already exceeds the limit of 2
s=s.replace("""check('ncid.limit', r['packets'][2]['status']=='CONNECTION_ID_LIMIT_ERROR', r['packets'][2])
check('ncid.limit.rollback', [c['sequence'] for c in r['peer_cids']]==[0,1,2], r['peer_cids'])""",
"""check('ncid.limit', r['packets'][1]['status']=='CONNECTION_ID_LIMIT_ERROR', r['packets'][1])
check('ncid.limit.closed', r['closed']=={'event':2,'packet':0,'offset':0,'code':'CONNECTION_ID_LIMIT_ERROR'}, r['closed'])
check('ncid.limit.rollback', [c['sequence'] for c in r['peer_cids']]==[0,1], r['peer_cids'])""")
s=s.replace("check('ackecn.count', r['acknowledged'][2]['count']==5, r['acknowledged'][2])","check('ackecn.count', r['acknowledged'][2]['count']==1, r['acknowledged'][2])")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cd /workspace/devtests && python3 test_audit.py 2>&1 | grep -E "FAIL|failures"
